questions.passage: He <u>ⓐ dedicated</u> his life to exploring and documenting the wonders of the underwater world. As a young man, he dreamed of becoming a pilot, but then he <u>ⓑ broke</u> both of his arms in a terrible car accident. As part of his physical therapy, Cousteau began swimming. He became <u>ⓒ intriguing</u> by the mysteries of the ocean, and he <u>ⓓ wanted</u> to explore further. However, the diving equipment <u>ⓔ available</u> at that time was insufficient.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] He became intriguing by the mysteries of the ocean → [해석] 그는 바다의 신비에 흥미를 느끼게 되었다. 감정을 나타내는 분사 형용사에서, 주어가 감정을 느끼는 사람이면 과거분사(-ed)를 사용해야 합니다. intriguing(흥미롭게 하는)은 사물 주어에, intrigued(흥미를 느끼는)는 사람 주어에 사용합니다. 따라서 He became intrigued가 올바른 표현입니다.
det.correct:
ⓐ dedicated: dedicate A to B(A를 B에 바치다) 구문의 과거형. 주어 He에 수 일치 정확 ✅
ⓑ broke: break-broke-broken의 과거형. 과거 사건 서술로 적절 ✅
ⓒ intriguing: 주어가 사람(He)이므로 감정분사는 과거분사 intrigued가 되어야 함 ❌ → intrigued ✅
ⓓ wanted: want + to부정사 구문으로 적절. 과거 시제 일치 ✅
ⓔ available: 후치수식 형용사. the diving equipment available(이용 가능한 잠수 장비) ✅
det.tip: 🔑 감정분사 구별법: 사람 주어 → -ed(감정을 느끼는), 사물 주어 → -ing(감정을 유발하는). 예: I am interested in... / The book is interesting. 유사: surprised/surprising, excited/exciting, bored/boring

questions.passage: She was a brilliant student, but health problems prevented her from (A) [attending / to attend] university. However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her (B) [moving / to move] forward, and she continued her studies on her own. Procter accumulated extensive knowledge of zoology. She began (C) [exchanging / to exchange] letters with George Boulenger, a prominent expert on reptiles, in order to share ideas.
questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] (A) prevented her from attending / (B) kept her moving / (C) began exchanging → [해석] (A) 건강 문제가 그녀가 대학에 다니는 것을 막았다. (B) 동물학에 대한 열정이 너무 강해서 그녀가 계속 나아가게 했다. (C) 그녀는 파충류 전문가인 George Boulenger와 편지를 교환하기 시작했다.
det.correct:
① attending – moving – exchanging ✅: (A) prevent + O + from + v-ing 구문. (B) keep + O + v-ing(계속 ~하게 하다). (C) begin + v-ing.
② to attend ❌: prevent는 from + v-ing를 취함. to부정사 불가.
③ to move ❌: keep + O + v-ing 구문에서 to부정사 불가.
④ to exchange: begin은 to-v도 가능하나, 원문 기준 exchanging이 자연스러움.
⑤ 세 가지 모두 to부정사로 (A)(B) 문법 오류 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 prevent/stop/keep + O + from + v-ing: ~가 …하는 것을 막다. keep + O + v-ing: ~가 계속 …하게 하다(from 없이). begin/start + v-ing 또는 to-v 둘 다 가능.

ch: attending – moving – exchanging
to attend – moving – exchanging
attending – to move – exchanging
attending – moving – to exchange
to attend – to move – to exchange

questions.passage: From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about <u>ⓐ drawing</u>. However, his dream of studying art in college was disrupted when he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency during high school. Surprisingly, he didn't allow this misfortune <u>ⓑ discouraging</u> him. Instead, he simply viewed his condition as a minor issue <u>ⓒ that</u> could happen to anyone. Although he graduated with a degree in economics, he searched for a job <u>ⓓ related</u> to art that wouldn't involve working with colors.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] he didn't allow this misfortune discouraging him → [해석] 그는 이 불행이 자신을 낙담시키도록 허용하지 않았다. allow + 목적어 + to부정사 구문이므로 discouraging(v-ing)은 어법에 맞지 않고, to discourage로 고쳐야 합니다.
det.correct:
ⓐ drawing: 전치사 about 뒤에 동명사(v-ing) 사용 적절. be enthusiastic about + v-ing ✅
ⓑ discouraging: allow + O + to-v 구문에서 v-ing 불가 ❌ → to discourage ✅
ⓒ that: 선행사 a minor issue를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 ✅
ⓓ related: 과거분사의 후치수식. a job related to art(예술과 관련된 직업) ✅
det.tip: 🔑 allow + O + to-v: ~가 …하도록 허락하다. 5형식 목적격보어 to-v 동사: allow, enable, encourage, force, permit, persuade, advise. cf. make/let/have + O + 원형부정사

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be (A) [demanding / relaxing]. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others (B) [struggle / manage] to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with (C) [guidance / confusion] and the sense of purpose they need to succeed.
questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] (A) can be demanding (B) others struggle to define them (C) providing them with guidance → [해석] (A) 진로를 설계하는 것은 힘든 일이 될 수 있다. (B) 다른 십대들은 목표를 정의하는 데 어려움을 겪는다. (C) 안내와 목적의식을 제공함으로써.
det.correct:
① demanding – struggle – guidance ✅: 세 가지 모두 문맥에 적합.
② relaxing ❌: 진로 설계가 편안하다면 뒤의 어려움 문맥과 모순.
③ manage ❌: manage to(가까스로 해내다)는 성공 의미. struggle과 반대.
④ confusion ❌: 롤모델이 혼란을 제공한다는 것은 부적절.
⑤ 세 가지 모두 문맥과 반대 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 demanding ≈ challenging, difficult ↔ relaxing, easy. struggle to-v ≈ have difficulty v-ing ↔ manage to-v(가까스로 해내다). guidance ≈ direction, advice ↔ confusion(혼란)

det.ref: [원문] the diving equipment available at that time was insufficient → [해석] 그 당시 이용 가능한 잠수 장비는 불충분했다. 원문은 insufficient이며, sufficient(충분한)은 문맥과 반대됩니다.
det.correct:
① dedicated ✅: dedicate A to B(바치다). 적절.
② sufficient ❌: 원문 insufficient(불충분한). 장비가 충분했다면 직접 만들 이유 없음. Instead of giving up과 연결 불가.
③ succeeded ✅: succeed in v-ing(성공하다). 적절.
④ compelling ✅: compelling(매력적인, 설득력 있는). 다큐멘터리 수식어로 적절.

det.tip: 🔑 sufficient(충분한) ↔ insufficient(불충분한). 접두사 in-/im-/ir-/il- = not(부정). 문맥 단서: "Instead of giving up, he decided to create his own" → 기존 장비 부족 암시.

det.ref: [원문] her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward → [해석] 동물학에 대한 열정이 너무 강해서 계속 나아가게 했다. weak(약한)은 문맥과 반대입니다.

det.ref: [원문] However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward → [해석] 그러나 동물학에 대한 열정이 너무 강해서 계속 나아가게 했다. However(역접)로 앞 문장과 연결 + 뒤 문장 continued her studies on her own과 자연스럽게 연결.
det.correct:
① give up her dream ❌: continued her studies와 모순.
② asked parents for a tutor ❌: on her own(혼자서)과 모순.
③ passion was so strong ✅: However(역접) + 열정으로 전진 → continued studies on her own과 연결.
④ found a university ❌: on her own과 모순.
⑤ different career path ❌: zoology 공부 지속과 모순.
det.tip: 🔑 빈칸(문장): 앞 문장(대학 불가) → 역접(However) → 빈칸(열정으로 극복) → 뒤 문장(혼자 공부 지속). so ~ that 결과 구문도 단서.

ch: As a result, she decided to give up her dream of studying zoology entirely.
Therefore, she asked her parents to find a private tutor for her.
However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward.
Moreover, she found a university that accepted students with health conditions.
Consequently, she turned her attention to a completely different career path.

questions.passage: From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing. However, his dream of studying art in college was disrupted when he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency during high school. Surprisingly, he didn't allow this misfortune to discourage him. Instead, he simply viewed his condition as a minor issue that could happen to anyone. Although he graduated with a degree in economics, he searched for a job related to art that wouldn't involve working with colors.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "a minor issue that could happen to anyone"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] he simply viewed his condition as a minor issue that could happen to anyone → [해석] 자신의 상태를 누구에게나 일어날 수 있는 사소한 문제로 바라봄. 장애에 좌절하지 않고 긍정적 태도 유지.
det.correct:
① unaware of seriousness ❌: 몰랐던 것이 아니라 알면서도 긍정적 대처. Surprisingly와 didn't allow ~ to discourage가 근거.
② maintained a positive attitude ✅: didn't allow ~ to discourage + simply viewed에서 긍정적 태도 확인.
③ everyone has color vision deficiency ❌: 모두가 가지고 있다는 의미가 아닌, 누구에게나 일어날 수 있는 정도의 문제로 봄.
④ drawing was not important ❌: 오히려 그림에 열정적.
⑤ hide his condition ❌: 숨기려 했다는 내용 없음.
det.tip: 🔑 함축 의미 파악: 전후 문맥 확인. Surprisingly → 예상과 다른 반응. didn't allow ~ to discourage → 낙담 거부. simply viewed ~ as minor → 대수롭지 않게 여김 = 긍정적 태도.

ch: He was unaware of how serious his condition actually was.
He maintained a positive attitude by not letting his disability define him.
He believed that everyone in the world has color vision deficiency.
He thought that drawing was not an important skill for his future career.
He wanted to hide his condition from the people around him.

questions.passage:
[주어진 글] Joan Procter was a notable zoologist who specialized in reptiles in the early 20th century. She taught me that devotion to a particular field is important for shaping one's career.

(A) She began exchanging letters with George Boulenger, a prominent expert on reptiles, in order to share ideas. He was so impressed that he hired her as his assistant at the British Museum.

(B) During her childhood, Procter immersed herself in the exploration of nature and animals. Although her father hated reptiles, she kept lizards, snakes, and even a baby crocodile as pets.

(C) A few years later, she became the first female curator of reptiles at the London Zoo. There, she actively contributed to the design of the Reptile House by incorporating new technology.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] 주어진 글: Procter는 파충류 전문 동물학자 → (B) 어린 시절 자연 탐험, 파충류 애완동물 → (A) Boulenger와 편지, 조수로 고용 → (C) 런던 동물원 큐레이터, Reptile House 설계.
det.correct:
③ (B)–(A)–(C) ✅: 시간순: 어린 시절(B) → 전문가 교류(A) → 경력 발전(C). (B) During her childhood → (A) She began exchanging letters → (C) A few years later.
① (A)-(B)-(C) ❌: 전문가 교류가 어린 시절보다 먼저 올 수 없음.
② (A)-(C)-(B) ❌: 시간순서 역전.
④ (B)-(C)-(A) ❌: 큐레이터(C)가 조수(A) 전에 올 수 없음.
⑤ (C)-(A)-(B) ❌: 완전 역전.
det.tip: 🔑 순서배열: 시간 표현(childhood → began → a few years later) + 지시어/대명사(She, He) + 인과관계(관심 → 교류 → 경력).

det.ref: [해석] ③ 월트 디즈니 애니메이션 스튜디오는 설립 이래 수많은 수상작을 제작해 왔다. — Kim 개인의 역경 극복 이야기와 무관한 회사 일반 정보입니다.

③ ❌: 디즈니 스튜디오 수상 이력은 Kim 개인 이야기와 무관. 흐름 방해.
④ ✅: 상태를 사소한 문제로 여김 → ②의 구체적 설명.
⑤ ✅: 경제학 학위 후 예술 관련 직업 탐색 → 이야기 전개.
det.tip: 🔑 무관문장: 중심 소재(Kim의 역경 극복) 파악 → 주어가 갑자기 바뀌는 문장(Kim → Walt Disney Studios) 주목.

questions.passage: During her childhood, Procter immersed herself in the exploration of nature and animals. Although her father hated reptiles, she kept lizards, snakes, and even a baby crocodile as pets. They were special companions that she loved and took care of.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 글의 내용과 맞으면 T, 틀리면 F를 고르시오.

"Joan Procter의 아버지는 파충류에 대한 그녀의 관심을 지지했다."

det.ref: [원문] Although her father hated reptiles, she kept lizards, snakes, and even a baby crocodile as pets. → [해석] 아버지가 파충류를 싫어했지만, 그녀는 도마뱀, 뱀, 아기 악어를 키웠다. 아버지는 싫어했으므로 "지지했다"는 거짓(F).
det.correct:
T ❌: Although(양보 접속사) 뒤에 hated(싫어했다)가 나옴. 지지했다면 양보절 불필요.
F ✅: hated(싫어했다) ≠ supported(지지했다). 반의어 관계.
det.tip: 🔑 TF 판별: 핵심 동사 대조. 지지(supported) vs 싫어(hated) = 반의어 → F. Although 양보절은 주절과 대조 내용.

ch: T (맞다)
F (틀리다)

questions.passage: As a young man, he dreamed of becoming a pilot, but then he broke both of his arms in a terrible car accident. As part of his physical therapy, Cousteau began swimming. He became ____________ (intrigue) by the mysteries of the ocean, and he wanted to explore further.
questions.stem:
빈칸에 주어진 단어의 올바른 형태를 쓰시오.

He became ____________ (intrigue) by the mysteries of the ocean.

det.ref: [원문] He became intrigued by the mysteries of the ocean → [해석] 그는 바다의 신비에 흥미를 느끼게 되었다. become + 과거분사: 주어가 사람이고 감정 상태를 나타내므로 과거분사(intrigued) 사용.
det.correct:
intrigued ✅: 감정동사 intrigue의 과거분사. 주어 사람(He) + by + 감정 원인 → 수동/과거분사형.
intriguing ❌: 현재분사(능동). 사물 주어에 사용.
intrigue ❌: 동사원형은 become 뒤에 불가(become + 형용사/분사).
det.tip: 🔑 become + p.p.(감정분사): become interested/excited/intrigued/surprised. 사람 → -ed, 사물 → -ing. by + 원인은 과거분사 단서.
